[{"word":"transmit","pronun":"[trænzˈmɪtˌtrænsˈmɪt]","translation":"vt. 传输；传播；发射；传达；遗传
vi. 传输；发射信号","audio":"transmit.mp3"},{"word":"transplant","pronun":"[trænsˈplæntˌtrænzˈplænt]","translation":"n. 移植；移植器官；被移植物；移居者

vt. 运输；流放；使狂喜","audio":"transport.mp3"},{"word":"traverse","pronun":"[ˈtrævɜːrs; trəˈvɜːrs]","translation":"n. 穿过；横贯；横木
vt. 穿过；反对；详细研究；在…来回移动
vi. 横越；旋转；来回移动
adj. 横贯的","audio":"traverse.mp3"},{"word":"treaty","pronun":"[ˈtriːti]","translation":"n. 条约，协议；谈判","audio":"treaty.mp3"},{"word":"tremendous","pronun":"[trəˈmendəs]","translation":"adj. 极大的，巨大的；惊人的；极好的","audio":"tremendous.mp3"},{"word":"trench","pronun":"[trentʃ]","translation":"n. 沟，沟渠；战壕；堑壕

vi. 挖战壕；侵害","audio":"trench.mp3"},{"word":"trend","pronun":"[trend]","translation":"n. 趋势，倾向；走向
vt. 使…趋向
vi. 趋向，伸向","audio":"trend.mp3"},{"word":"trial","pronun":"[ˈtraɪəl]","translation":"n. 试验；审讯；努力；磨炼
adj. 试验的；审讯的","audio":"trial.mp3"},{"word":"tribe","pronun":"[traɪb]","translation":"n. 部落；族；宗族；一伙","audio":"tribe.mp3"},{"word":"tribute","pronun":"[ˈtrɪbjuːt]","translation":"n. 礼物；[税收] 贡物；颂词；（尤指对死者的）致敬，悼念，吊唁礼物","audio":"tribute.mp3"},{"word":"trifle","pronun":"[ˈtraɪfl]","translation":"n. 琐事；蛋糕；少量

vi. 开玩笑；闲混；嘲弄","audio":"trifle.mp3"},{"word":"trigger","pronun":"[ˈtrɪɡər]","translation":"n. 扳机；[电子] 触发器；制滑机
vt. 引发，引起；触发
vi. 松开扳柄","audio":"trigger.mp3"},{"word":"triple","pronun":"[ˈtrɪpl]","translation":"n. 三倍数；三个一组
adj. 三倍的；三方的
vt. 使成三倍
vi. 增至三倍","audio":"triple.mp3"},{"word":"triumph","pronun":"[ˈtraɪʌmf]","translation":"n. 胜利，凯旋；欢欣
vi. 获得胜利，成功","audio":"triumph.mp3"},{"word":"trivial","pronun":"[ˈtrɪviəl]","translation":"adj. 不重要的，琐碎的；琐细的","audio":"trivial.mp3"},{"word":"tub","pronun":"[tʌb]","translation":"n. 浴盆；桶

vi. 洗盆浴；（衣服等）被放在桶里洗","audio":"tub.mp3"},{"word":"tuck","pronun":"[tʌk]","translation":"n. 食物；船尾突出部；缝摺；抱膝式跳水；活力；鼓声
vt. 卷起；挤进；用某物舒适地裹住；使有褶裥；收拢；大口吃；使隐藏
vi. 缝褶裥；缩拢；舒服地裹在里面；大口吃","audio":"tuck.mp3"},{"word":"tug","pronun":"[tʌɡ]","translation":"n. 拖船；拖曳；苦干
vt. 用力拉；较量；用拖船拖
vi. 用力拉；竞争；努力做","audio":"tug.mp3"},{"word":"tuition","pronun":"[tuˈɪʃn]","translation":"n. 学费；讲授","audio":"tuition.mp3"}]
